description: This file is a Java utility class for database operations related to 'Enquiry' objects, providing methods to retrieve, insert, update, and delete enquiries in the database.

classes.name: EnquiryDBUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to perform CRUD operations on 'Enquiry' records in the database.

methods.name: getAllEnquiry
methods.description: Retrieves all enquiry records from the database and returns them as a list of Enquiry objects.

methods.name: insertEnquiry
methods.description: Inserts a new enquiry record into the database with specified email, subject, and comments.

methods.name: updateEnquiry
methods.description: Updates the response for a specific enquiry identified by EnID.

methods.name: deleteEnquiry
methods.description: Deletes an enquiry record from the database based on EnID.
